Our Solutions

Enterprise Communication Infrastructure

Carrier-grade solutions powered by StarRoute™ technology and enterprise-grade StarSecure™ encryption. Trusted by businesses worldwide.

NajmVoIP

Premium VoIP with StarRoute™ intelligent routing. HD call quality, advanced IVR, call center integration, and StarDash™ real-time analytics.

NajmFAX

Cloud fax with StarSecure™ enterprise encryption. HIPAA/GDPR compliant for healthcare, legal, and financial institutions requiring regulatory adherence.

NajmNetwork

Expert telecom consultancy, NajmDialer integration, network architecture, StarSync™ CRM connectivity, and AI-powered solutions. Your infrastructure, future-proof.

Why NajmX

Stand Out Among a Million Stars

Enterprise-grade telecommunications infrastructure with star-branded features designed for reliability, security, and performance.

StarRoute™

Intelligent routing algorithms select the best carriers in real-time, ensuring crystal-clear HD voice quality and optimal connection paths worldwide.

StarDash™

Comprehensive analytics dashboards track call quality, system performance, cost analysis, and usage patterns. Make data-driven decisions with confidence.

StarSync™

Seamlessly integrate with your existing CRM systems, deploy AI-powered voice agents, and automate workflows for maximum efficiency.

StarSecure™

Bank-level encryption, secure SIP trunking, fraud detection, and compliance with international telecommunications and data protection standards.

Flexible Packages

Choose from Starter ⭐, Pro ⭐⭐, or Enterprise ⭐⭐⭐ packages tailored to your needs. Transparent pricing with no hidden fees.

StarCare™ Support

Multilingual technical experts available 24/7 across Egypt, UK, and US time zones. Your success is our priority with dedicated StarCare™ support.

NajmX Tech Solutions
